title: Fix null TLAS handle and unify volume descriptor layout (resolve VUID 07990)
rationale: Validation shows VUID 07990 at pipeline creation (shader expects ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_KHR at binding 3; layout expects COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER). Logs also show m_topLevelAS handle is VK_NULL_HANDLE at init. This CR ensures the descriptor set layout used by BOTH volume pipelines defines binding 3 as AS_KHR when RT is enabled, removes legacy DSM binding-3 code paths, and fixes TLAS construction so the handle is non-null before first use.

edits.action: Create a single function (e.g., buildVolumeDescriptorSetLayout(bool rtEnabled)) that always constructs the descriptor set layout fresh and returns it. When rtEnabled==true, binding 3 descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_KHR; when false, either (a) remove binding 3 entirely if shader compiled without RT, or (b) keep binding 3 as DSM only in a non-RT shader variant (do not mix). Use the same returned layout for BOTH SDR and HDR pipeline creation calls. Remove/replace any legacy code that sets binding 3 to COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER in RT builds.

Ensure TLAS is actually created (vkCreateAccelerationStructureKHR returns non-null handle) and built once before first volume draw. After TLAS creation, log the handle value and assert m_topLevelAS != VK_NULL_HANDLE. If TLAS build is deferred, gate RT path off (no binding 3 use) until the build completes, or create non-RT pipeline variant for the first frame.
Guard: only write/push binding 3 when (rtEnabled && m_topLevelAS != VK_NULL_HANDLE). Otherwise skip binding 3 entirely.

Provide two shader variants: (A) RT variant with layout(binding=3) accelerationStructureEXT; (B) non-RT variant with no binding 3 (or DSM only). Ensure the runtime chooses the matching pipeline/shader combo to avoid layout mismatch at creation.

instrumentation: At descriptor layout build: print binding types for 0..3 and the descriptor set layout handle
After vkCreateAccelerationStructureKHR(TLAS): print handle value; assert non-null
At pipeline creation: print pipeline layout handle and confirm it references the descriptor set layout from this frame
acceptance: No VUID 07990 at pipeline creation for both SDR and HDR volume pipelines
Log shows m_topLevelAS != VK_NULL_HANDLE before first RT descriptor push
Frame runs without RT layout/type validation errors
notes: Do not mix DSM and RT on the same binding index in a single shader variant
If RT is disabled at runtime, compile/bind the non-RT pipeline so that binding 3 is absent, avoiding layout mismatch
